text: 2020 Rate Supported Budget Launch, with presentations from City Officials on the following: - Toronto Water - 2020 Staff Recommended Operating Budget and 2020-2029 Staff Recommended Capital Budget and Plan - Solid Waste Management Services - 2020 Staff Recommended Operating Budget and 2020-2029 Staff Recommended Capital Budget and Plan - Toronto Parking Authority - 2020 Staff Recommended Operating Budget and 2020-2029 Staff Recommended Capital Budget and Plan Materials will be distributed at the meeting and posted online at toronto.ca/council .
